assessment.evidence: Across 25 completed successful treatment RF fits (80,611-82,394 rows; selected forests 200 or 500 trees), 202 executed tuning phases plus 25 selected final-fit phases all have recorded peak RSS; maximum across all is below 4 GiB. The maximum is 3,907,392 KiB (3.72 GiB), leaving 1.28 GiB to a 5 GiB reservation. Across later-admission controller samples, the maximum PSS observation is 3,184,574,464 bytes (2.97 GiB).
assessment.failed_trials: No failed or nonzero tuning phase was recorded in the 25 successful fit histories: 202 executed trial phases succeeded and 48 duplicate_cached slots reused earlier observations. The saved histories show no failed trial counterexample.
assessment.not_a_guarantee: The controller PSS data are sparse bracketed snapshots, not continuous peaks. One attempted worker lacks any positive persisted controller PSS sample, three fit workers are still running and excluded from completed maxima, and only the completed/successful fit domain is covered. This does not establish a mathematical worst case or cover larger rows, >500 trees, or other methods.
assessment.preserve_limits: Any future lower reservation is admission planning only; retain 10 GiB worker hard limit, 600-second trial/phase limits, and dynamic promotion to 10 GiB. No changed limits are supported here.
assessment.verdict: SUPPORTS ONLY A PROVISIONAL 5 GiB ADMISSION RESERVATION WITH THE EXISTING 10 GiB HARD CAP AND PROMOTION GUARD.

controller_process_tree_pss_samples.source_semantics: Controller sums smaps_rollup PSS across a running worker tree, capped by VmRSS and 10GiB; stored value is the maximum of two bracketed instantaneous samples at later admissions, not a continuous per-fit peak.
